name: @313automations/mcp-server
description: A Multi-purpose Conversation Platform (MCP) server with a suite of tools for various automation and data interaction tasks.

MCP_SERVER_PORT.description: The port on which the server will run. Defaults to 3133.

MCP_SERVER_HOST.description: The host address for the server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

MCP_SERVER_LOG_LEVEL.description: The logging level. Can be `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. Defaults to `info`.

MCP_SERVER_API_KEY.description: A secret key for securing the server's API. If not set, the API will be open.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Executes a shell command on the server.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Reads the content of a file on the server.

path.description: The path to the file to read.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Writes content to a file on the server.

path.description: The path to the file to write to.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

npx.description: Run the server directly using npx without cloning the repository.

source.description: Install and run from source code after cloning the repository (`git clone ...`), installing dependencies (`npm install`), and then running this command from the project directory.
